heading: Subpoenas to officers or members of crew
lead: An officer or member of the crew of a public vessel may not be subpoenaed in a civil action under this chapter without the consent of—

tree.text: the Secretary of the department or the head of the independent establishment having control of the vessel at the time the cause of action arose; or
the master or commanding officer of the vessel at the time the subpoena is issued.
